business_summary: Zhejiang Top Cloud-agri Technology Co.,Ltd. provides smart agriculture services and solutions in China and internationally. The company offers digital plant protection, including intelligent monitoring and early warning solution for major crop diseases and pests, and smart plant protection service online platform solution; germplasm resource integrated intelligent control platform, smart seed production integrated, and smart seed industry full-chain management solution; and whole habitat solution for crops, AI-enabled solutions for the comprehensive utilization of saline-alkali land, digital and intelligent scientific research base construction, digital breeding, and smart agriculture professional construction solution. It also provides rural brain integrated, digital agricultural service integrated, industry brain integrated, integrated solutions for modern agricultural parks, digital datian construction, smart tea garden, smart orchard, smart facility agriculture integrated solution, and ai plant factory solution. In addition, the company offers supplementary farmland quality assessment, farmland quality protection, digital construction solution for the third national soil survey, high-standard farmland full-cycle management and service platform, and intelligent water-saving irrigation and precision management solution; and forest pest monitoring and early warning, forest chief system and patrol management, forest tree seedling laboratory construction plan solutions, and solution for wetland ecosystem observation and research station. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Top Instrument Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zhejiang Top Cloud-agri Technology Co.,Ltd. in May 2015. Zhejiang Top Cloud-agri Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
